content: Looks like a fun puzzle! Rules * Optional: consider adding "to" between "move" and "or shoot into" (noting that "to" is used after "move" in the Output section). * Please specify whether two or more features (bats, a shaft, the Mumpus) can occupy the same room. * Please specify whether bats and the Mumpus always remains in their initial rooms or can move during the game. Expert rules * "After transporting you, the bat flies away, leaving the original room unoccupied": what exactly happens to the bat afterwards? • Does it leave the cave entirely? • Does it move to another room? • If so, does it choose an unexplored room or any room at random? • Can it move into a room that already contains a hazard? • If it prefers unexplored safe rooms, what happens when none remain? My assumption is that the bat simply leaves the cave, but it'd be helpful to state this explicitly. * Optional: consider adding "to" between "move" and "or shoot into" here as well. Input * Please add "space-separated" after each of the three occurrences of "Three". Input for a game round * Please add line numbers, for example: Line 1: One integer (etc.) Similarly for Lines 2 and 3. * Please add "the room IDs of" before "the three adjacent rooms". * For the clue inputs, please add ", 0 otherwise" to each description. Output * Please change "One command" to "One of the following commands". * Please format "MOVE" and "SHOOT" using the tag instead of . * Please format "roomId" using the tag instead of . Constraints * Please format all variable names using the tag. * Optional: it'd be helpful to specify the range of valid room IDs (0 to roomCount - 1?). * Please specify that the starting room is always safe and free of bats. * If solvability is guaranteed, please state that every case can be solved without guessing. Stub generator * Interesting; I didn't know it was possible to include a variable directly in a write statement. How did you write that? Cases, viewer and error messages * I'll review these once the above points have been addressed. Thanks.
